title: ICAB V2 - Strategic Business Management & Leadership
summary: Integrates strategic management, digital leadership, corporate restructuring, advanced financial strategy, enterprise risk management (ERM), and ethical leadership in complex real-world scenarios.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Strategic Business Management and Leadership. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Business & Digital Strategy and Leadership
stages.name: Area 1: Business & Digital Strategy and Leadership
stages.description: Strategic leadership, executive vision, digital transformation, enterprise agility, and ERM.

nodes.name: Executive Leadership, Digital Transformation & ERM
nodes.description: Strategic leadership styles; organizational agility; digital business strategy and platform ecosystems; Enterprise Risk Management (COSO ERM framework); business model disruption and turnaround strategies for distressed companies.
topics: Leadership models: Transformational, transactional, servant, and situational leadership
Strategic vision formulation and leading organizational change under severe market disruption
Digital transformation strategy: Cloud platforms, AI integration, IoT, and API ecosystems
COSO Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework: Governance, Strategy, Performance, Review
Corporate turnaround strategies: Retrenchment, restructuring, refinancing, and repositioning
Executive talent management, board succession planning, and corporate culture alignment
learningOutcomes: Formulate digital transformation strategies for traditional businesses.
Design and implement COSO ERM frameworks across operating divisions.
Develop turnaround plans for distressed business enterprises.
checklists: Read Executive Leadership, Digital Transformation & ERM in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Financial Strategy & Restructuring
stages.name: Area 2: Financial Strategy & Restructuring
stages.description: Corporate restructuring, MBOs, spin-offs, demergers, international treasury, and valuation.

nodes.name: M&A, Management Buyouts (MBOs) & International Treasury
nodes.description: Corporate reorganization: Spin-offs, demergers, equity carve-outs, Management Buyouts (MBO/MBI); leveraged buyouts (LBOs) and mezzanine financing; international treasury: Cross-border cash pooling, multilateral netting, and global capital raising; enterprise valuation in complex transactions.
topics: Restructuring strategies: Demergers, spin-offs, carve-outs, liquidation of non-core assets
Management Buyouts (MBOs) and Buy-ins (MBIs): Deal structuring, venture capital backing, warranties
Leveraged Buyout (LBO) financial engineering: Senior debt, mezzanine finance, equity sweetners
International treasury management: Cash pooling (notional vs physical), multilateral netting centers
Global capital raising: ADRs, GDRs, foreign currency sovereign and corporate bonds
Financial defense tactics against hostile takeovers: Poison pills, white knights, crown jewel defense
learningOutcomes: Structure MBO and LBO financial packages with optimal debt-equity layers.
Design international cash management and pooling arrangements.
Formulate anti-takeover defenses for public listed entities.
checklists: Read M&A, Management Buyouts (MBOs) & International Treasury in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: Integrated Governance, Ethics, Assurance & ESG
stages.name: Area 3: Integrated Governance, Ethics, Assurance & ESG
stages.description: Integrated Reporting (<IR> Framework), ethical leadership, board effectiveness, and ESG stewardship.

nodes.name: Integrated Reporting (<IR>), Board Stewardship & ESG Governance
nodes.description: International <IR> Framework (Six Capitals: Financial, Manufactured, Intellectual, Human, Social & Relationship, Natural); corporate governance failures and board oversight; ethical decision-making frameworks; ESG governance, biodiversity, and climate stewardship.
topics: International Integrated Reporting (<IR>) Framework: Six Capitals and value creation over time
Connectivity of information: Linking strategic objectives, risks, performance, and remuneration
Board effectiveness evaluation, audit committee oversight of non-financial metrics
Ethical leadership dilemmas: Whistleblower protection, executive pay disparities, supply chain labor
Corporate climate stewardship aligned with Bangladesh's Delta Plan 2100 and SDG targets
Assurance over integrated reports and non-financial performance indicators
learningOutcomes: Draft an Integrated Report applying the Six Capitals framework.
Advise corporate boards on executive compensation and governance alignment.
Establish ESG stewardship systems resilient to global supply chain audits.
checklists: Read Integrated Reporting (<IR>), Board Stewardship & ESG Governance in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
